items.title: The Kristi Noem Statue Nobody Asked For
items.summary: Today, two very different visions of civic life: the care and repair of the Medina Triennial, and a sculpture in celebration of a reviled former Homeland Security secretary.

items.title: Art as Infrastructure at the Medina Triennial
items.summary: The inaugural edition of the sprawling yet rigorous exhibition examines the labor, regulation, extraction, and repair of our shared systems.

items.title: Who Stole the Guggenheim’s Picasso?
items.summary: The museum sues to retrieve a piece stolen in 1961, Dean Millien’s aluminum-foil animal sculptures, and more.

items.title: Taiwanese Artists Accuse South Korea’s Gwangju Biennale of Censorship
items.summary: The Biennale’s decision to exclude “Taiwan” from the pavilion’s official name “is a threat to freedom of expression and the global art community,” the artists said.
